title: How AI is helping geologists identify thousands of slopes around the world at high risk of slipping by analyzing data from satellites and ground-based sensors (Chris Baraniuk/BBC)
summary: Chris Baraniuk / BBC: How AI is helping geologists identify thousands of slopes around the world at high risk of slipping by analyzing data from satellites and ground-based sensors — Sudden and unexpected, landslides and avalanches claim thousands of lives each year and cause billions of dollars in damage.
